mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_ocr_jobs WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM repair_ocr_jobs WHERE purchase_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM repair_ocr_jobs WHERE attempts < 2 AND ((status='QUEUED' AND next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))) ORDER BY next_run_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_ocr_jobs SET status='FAILED',error_code='WORKER_LEASE_EXHAUSTED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status='RUNNING' AND attempts >=2 AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) LIMIT 100

UPDATE repair_ocr_jobs SET status=#{status},result=#{result},error_code=#{error},provider_request_id=#{requestId},next_run_at=#{nextRun}, lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
